items.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: if you’re playing tenor saxophone he should hear Ben Webster or Illinois Jacquet, Lester Young, Don Byas, Gene Ammons.

ctx.x: Usually there’s one or two people that will speak to you I think, you know?

But the more the merrier. Because there’s a lot of great players. You know you’ve got, my biggest complaint out there is young players they exclude so many of the great players of the past and if you’re playing tenor saxophone he should hear Ben Webster or Illinois Jacquet, Lester Young, Don Byas, Gene Ammons. None of these players should be excluded from your listening habits. © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
You were part of the Jauggernaut?
